# Contract: Get Task by ID

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- a PostgreSQL 16 server is reachable at the `DATABASE_URL` provided by `.env.test`, and its role can create and drop databases (each item runs against its own isolated database)
- the `task-api` service built from this repository is available both as an in-process router and as a spawnable binary (`cargo run` or the compiled `task-api` executable)
- a Rust stable toolchain ≥ 1.100 with the `rustfmt` and `clippy` components is installed

**Persistent state:**
- `migrated-db` — a PostgreSQL database exists on which every migration shipped so far has been applied exactly once with matching checksums; the `tasks` table exists and holds zero rows unless an item's `given` adds rows. Used by: API-GET-01, API-GET-02, API-GET-03, API-GET-04, API-GET-05, API-INVALID-ID-01, API-INVALID-ID-02, API-INVALID-ID-03, API-INVALID-ID-04, API-INVALID-ID-05, API-INVALID-ID-06, API-NOT-FOUND-01, API-NOT-FOUND-02, API-NOT-FOUND-03, API-REJECT-01, API-REJECT-02, API-REJECT-03.
- `known-task` — a row exists in `tasks` of `migrated-db` with `title` `Write PRD`, `description` `Draft the requirements`, `status` `in_progress`, `priority` `high`, `due_date` `2026-12-01`, and a server-generated `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`; it is the only row in the table. Used by: API-GET-01, API-GET-04, API-GET-05, API-NOT-FOUND-01, API-NOT-FOUND-02, API-NOT-FOUND-03, API-REJECT-01, API-REJECT-02, API-REJECT-03.
- `sparse-task` — a row exists in `tasks` of `migrated-db` with `title` `Bare`, `description` NULL, `status` `todo`, `priority` `medium`, `due_date` NULL, and a server-generated `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`; it is the only row in the table. Used by: API-GET-02.
- `seeded-10k-db` — a migrated PostgreSQL database whose `tasks` table holds exactly 10,000 rows with statuses and priorities spread across every allowed value and about one third of `due_date` values NULL. Used by: API-GET-06.

**Configuration:**
- `.env.test` at the repository root defines `DATABASE_URL` for the PostgreSQL 16 server above, and its variables are present in the environment of `cargo test`
- unless an item states otherwise: `HOST=127.0.0.1`, `PORT=<a free TCP port>`, `DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=10`, `DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS=5`, `DATABASE_URL` pointing to the item's database, `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES` unset
- `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true` mounts the diagnostic route `GET /__test/slow?ms=<0..30000>[&hold_db=true]`, used only by `API-INVALID-ID-06` and `API-REJECT-01` to hold the database pool's only connection; when the flag is unset or `false`, that path behaves as an unknown route
- `<random-uuid>` denotes a freshly generated UUID v4 in lowercase hyphenated form that is not the `id` of any row in `tasks`
- the `tasks` table can be read directly with SQL (outside the service) so items can assert stored rows

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Format** — `cargo fmt --check` — every source file is already rustfmt-formatted; the command exits 0 with no diff.
- **Lint** — `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` — all targets (library, binary, tests) compile with zero clippy warnings.
- **Tests** — `cargo test` — every unit and integration test passes against isolated `#[sqlx::test]` databases on the PostgreSQL server named by `.env.test`.
- **Offline build** — `SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build` — the project compiles from the committed `.sqlx/` metadata without contacting a database.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| `GET /tasks/{id}` for an existing task returns 200 with all 8 representation fields. | API-GET-01, API-GET-02, API-GET-03, API-GET-04 |
| `GET /tasks/not-a-uuid` returns 400 `invalid_id`. | API-INVALID-ID-01, API-INVALID-ID-02, API-INVALID-ID-03, API-INVALID-ID-04, API-INVALID-ID-05, API-INVALID-ID-06 |
| `GET /tasks/{random-uuid}` for a nonexistent task returns 404 `not_found` with the ID in the message. | API-NOT-FOUND-01, API-NOT-FOUND-02, API-NOT-FOUND-03 |
| p95 latency < 50 ms over 1,000 requests with 10,000 seeded tasks (release build, local). | API-GET-06 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service (in-process router or bound listener); assert response status, headers and body, response time where stated, and read the `tasks` table directly to assert stored rows.

### Get Task

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`.

#### `API-GET-01` — existing task returns every representation field
- given: (default), and `known-task` exists
- when: GET /tasks/{id of `known-task`}
- then:
  - status 200
  - header `Content-Type` is `application/json`
  - body has exactly the keys `id`, `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `due_date`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, in that order
  - body `id`, `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `due_date` are the `known-task` id, `Write PRD`, `Draft the requirements`, `in_progress`, `high`, `2026-12-01`
  - body `created_at` and `updated_at` equal the stored values rendered as RFC 3339 UTC with exactly three fractional digits and a `Z` suffix

#### `API-GET-02` — absent optional fields are returned as null
- given: (default), and `sparse-task` exists
- when: GET /tasks/{id of `sparse-task`}
- then:
  - status 200
  - body has all 8 representation keys
  - body `description` is `null`
  - body `due_date` is `null`
  - body `title`, `status`, `priority` are `Bare`, `todo`, `medium`

#### `API-GET-03` — get returns the same representation as create
- given: (default), `tasks` holds zero rows, and `POST /tasks` with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"Write PRD","priority":"high","due_date":"2026-12-01"}` has returned 201 with body `created-body`
- when: GET /tasks/{`id` of `created-body`}
- then:
  - status 200
  - the response body is byte-for-byte identical to `created-body`

#### `API-GET-04` — uppercase hex in the id is accepted
- given: (default), and `known-task` exists
- when: GET /tasks/{id of `known-task` with every hex letter uppercased}
- then:
  - status 200
  - body `id` is the `known-task` id in lowercase
  - body `title` is `Write PRD`

#### `API-GET-05` — reading does not modify the task
- given: (default), `known-task` exists, and its stored row (all 8 columns) has been recorded
- when: GET /tasks/{id of `known-task`}
- then:
  - status 200
  - the stored row for `known-task` is identical to the recorded row, including `updated_at`
  - `tasks` still holds exactly one row

#### `API-GET-06` — lookup stays fast with 10,000 tasks
- given: the service is running against `seeded-10k-db`
- when: send 1,000 sequential GET /tasks/{id} requests, each for an id taken from the seeded rows
- then:
  - every response has status 200
  - the 95th percentile of the response times is below 50 ms
- notes: the PRD names a local release build; a run against a debug build that meets the same bound also satisfies it

### Malformed Id

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`; `tasks` holds zero rows.

#### `API-INVALID-ID-01` — non-UUID text is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/not-a-uuid
- then:
  - status 400
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"invalid_id","message":"Task id must be a valid UUID","details":[]}}`

#### `API-INVALID-ID-02` — the 32-character simple UUID form is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/0b7d2c1e5f3a4e8b9c6d7a1f2e3d4c5b
- then:
  - status 400
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"invalid_id","message":"Task id must be a valid UUID","details":[]}}`

#### `API-INVALID-ID-03` — the URN UUID form is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/urn:uuid:0b7d2c1e-5f3a-4e8b-9c6d-7a1f2e3d4c5b
- then:
  - status 400
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"invalid_id","message":"Task id must be a valid UUID","details":[]}}`

#### `API-INVALID-ID-04` — near-miss UUIDs are rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/0b7d2c1e-5f3a-4e8b-9c6d-7a1f2e3d4c5g (non-hex final character)
- then:
  - status 400
  - body `error.code` is `invalid_id`
- notes: the same outcome is expected for a 35-character hyphenated value (`0b7d2c1e-5f3a-4e8b-9c6d-7a1f2e3d4c5`) and for hyphens in the wrong positions

#### `API-INVALID-ID-05` — an id that is not valid UTF-8 is rejected uniformly
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/%FF
- then:
  - status 400
  - header `Content-Type` is `application/json`
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"invalid_id","message":"Task id must be a valid UUID","details":[]}}`

#### `API-INVALID-ID-06` — a malformed id is rejected without database access
- given: the service runs against `migrated-db` with `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true`, `DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1` and `DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS=1`, and a `GET /__test/slow?ms=4000&hold_db=true` request is in flight holding the pool's only connection
- when: GET /tasks/abc
- then:
  - status 400
  - body `error.code` is `invalid_id`
  - the response arrives within 500 ms of sending the request

### Missing Task

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`; `known-task` exists.

#### `API-NOT-FOUND-01` — unknown id returns 404 naming the id
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/{`<random-uuid>`}
- then:
  - status 404
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Task <random-uuid> not found","details":[]}}` with `<random-uuid>` replaced by the requested id
  - `tasks` still holds exactly one row

#### `API-NOT-FOUND-02` — the message uses the lowercase id
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/{`<random-uuid>` with every hex letter uppercased}
- then:
  - status 404
  - body `error.message` is `Task <random-uuid> not found` with the id in lowercase

#### `API-NOT-FOUND-03` — the nil UUID is a well-formed id
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
- then:
  - status 404
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Task 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 not found","details":[]}}`

### Request Rejection

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`; `known-task` exists.

#### `API-REJECT-01` — unavailable database returns 503
- given: (default), and the service runs with `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true`, `DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1` and `DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS=1`, and a `GET /__test/slow?ms=4000&hold_db=true` request is in flight holding the pool's only connection
- when: GET /tasks/{id of `known-task`}
- then:
  - status 503
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"service_unavailable","message":"Database temporarily unavailable, please retry","details":[]}}`
  - the response arrives within 2.5 seconds of sending the request

#### `API-REJECT-02` — a method without a handler is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PUT /tasks/{id of `known-task`} with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"x"}`
- then:
  - status 405
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"method_not_allowed","message":"Method not allowed","details":[]}}`
  - the stored `known-task` row is unchanged

#### `API-REJECT-03` — a deeper path is an unknown route
- given: (default)
- when: GET /tasks/{id of `known-task`}/extra
- then:
  - status 404
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"Route not found","details":[]}}`
